title: The Archive of Kepler Reach
author: Ivo Zhou
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
